_comment: P33-H3 (Thomas 07.11: Tracker-Reset Instanz-Bindung) - tracker bind + close law, hand-pinned ground truth (NOT --record; same route as settings_load.json/action_tree.json - there is no RNG and no Python sim twin). Nachbau of the Player-33 oscillation: ops drive the SAME TrackerBindLaw functions HPTrackerContainer calls (open = ResetTracker(card) -> ResolveBoard + fresh wheel read + arm commit; set = player turns wheels; close = UpdateAndHide; hide = OnDisable commit rail; reactivate = parent re-enable WITHOUT a card read (CardViewPopup.ShowMissionCard rail)). p33_z745: the Z743-749 rhythm (damage entry, OK-double-click/Space-in-fade stray close) - the stray closes must SKIP: exactly five commits, NO commit [0,0,0]; the old code produced the extra zero-commit here. p33_z799: the Z796-798 triple [3,0,0]|[0,0,0]|[3,0,0] collapses to two honest [3,0,0] commits. twin_same_id_rebind + ghost_custom_card_dg009: the board-instance law - SagaDGPrefab.Init's ovrd.customCard swap and CreateCustomCard's inherited id put a same-id, DIFFERENT object in front of the popup; binds resolve to the deployed object, wheels re-read FROM BOARD, the twin is never written (HOTH12 globalEvents[8] carries exactly such a DG009 'Royal Guard' custom deployment). null_law_preview_hero: ids not on the board (setup previews, hero cards) keep the old bind-as-given path. hide_then_close: the Player-31 law (every hide commits) survives, the late close still skips. mission_card_reactivate: a re-enable without a fresh card read must NEVER re-arm the commit - the old OnEnable(wasVisible=true) re-armed a zero-wipe of the stale wheels.
